name: 01226 · Dalton, MA
findings: ZIP 01226 (Dalton) has 35 nonprofit organizations. 18 of them (51%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 16 organizations.
Social and fraternal organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (41% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 01226 (Dalton) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.
